name: Gamma
freeTierNote: $0 plan with starter one-time credits and watermarked exports — check official limits.
priceBand: Free starter credits; Plus — check official pricing
bestFor: First-pass slides when PowerPoint is a tax
skipIf: You must deliver a strictly branded Keynote with a designer in the loop
limitations: Generated decks need manual fact and contrast checks
Cannot match custom designer Keynote/Figma templates
summary: Prompt-to-deck. Fine for internal reviews. Dangerous if you present it to a client without editing.
body: Gamma is the slide version of Lovable: fast, generic until you push it, and a gift when you need ten screens by 5pm. Export and edit. Do not confuse a generated deck with a strategy. Plans checked 16 Sep 2026.
notes: Replace stock claims with your numbers
Check contrast; generated themes fail WCAG often
Not a replacement for Figma for product UI
